meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊想法问成一份可照做的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望在动手写代码前先得到一个清晰、完整、可执行的实施步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague ideas into an actionable development plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear, executable plan before writing any code.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会化身规划顾问 Prometheus:只读代码、搜索和分析,不写产品代码;会把模糊或庞大的要求先探索清楚,必要时提问,经你批准后产出一份下游执行者照着做、无需再追问的完整工作计划。
howto.when: 仅在用户明确点名“ulw-plan”“ulw plan”“/skill:ulw-plan”等关键词,或用自己话要求“编码前先做个计划”时触发;不会自行激活。

say.text: 进入 ulw-plan,给这个需求做计划,别写代码。
say.note: 开启规划模式,先探索代码,再交计划。

say.text: 编码前,把“登录加限流”拆成一份完整工作计划。
say.note: 它可能问一到两个问题,然后写入 .omo/plans。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 模式,把重构拆成一步一步的任务。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude becomes a planning consultant (Prometheus): it only explores read-only and never edits code. It researches vague requests, asks only necessary questions, then writes one complete work plan after your approval.
howto.when_en: Activates only on explicit user request: saying “ulw-plan”, “ulw plan”, “/skill:ulw-plan”, or asking for a work plan before coding in their own words. Never self-activates.

say_en.text: Enter ulw-plan and make a plan for this request—no coding.
say_en.note: Starts plan mode and explores code first.

say_en.text: Before coding, turn “rate-limit login” into a full work plan.
say_en.note: May ask one or two questions, then writes .omo/plans.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan mode to break the refactor into tasks.
say_en.note: Produces a plan file only; no implementation.
